pcapResources.title: Hackers on the Network PCAP
pcapResources.learningPurpose: Adversary intrusion triage, command-and-control (C2) beacon detection, and malicious payload analysis.
pcapResources.safetyGuidance: Educational PCAP containing adversary simulation traffic. Analyze within an isolated Wireshark environment without executing extracted payloads on host systems.
instructions: Download the file to your designated forensic analysis workspace.
Verify SHA256 integrity hash before opening.
Launch Wireshark and open the capture with a forensic inspection profile.
Apply display filters to isolate anomalous IP conversations.
pcapResources.verificationMethod: Direct SHA-256 computation from upstream git master raw source

pcapResources.title: Forensic Scenario 1 PCAP
pcapResources.learningPurpose: Multi-protocol baseline analysis, TCP stream reassembly, and TLS handshake inspection.
pcapResources.safetyGuidance: Synthetic enterprise baseline capture containing web browsing, DNS queries, and background service traffic.
instructions: Open in Wireshark and observe the Protocol Hierarchy statistics.
Filter for HTTP and TLS streams to identify external connections.
Practice stream reassembly to inspect conversation content.
pcapResources.verificationMethod: Direct SHA-256 computation from upstream git master raw source

pcapResources.title: Forensic Scenario 2 PCAP
pcapResources.learningPurpose: Reconnaissance scanning, SYN flood denial-of-service, and cleartext FTP credential recovery.
pcapResources.safetyGuidance: Contains synthetic port scanning and simulated attack traffic. Demonstration credentials only.
instructions: Load the PCAP into Wireshark or TShark.
Filter for ftp or ftp-data to recover unencrypted authentication credentials.
Inspect TCP SYN packets without ACK responses to quantify port scanning behavior.
pcapResources.verificationMethod: Direct SHA-256 computation from upstream git master raw source

pcapResources.title: Wireshark Foundation Sample Captures
pcapResources.learningPurpose: Reference captures for specialized protocols including DNSSEC, HTTP/2, SMB2/3, Kerberos, and VoIP SIP/RTP.
pcapResources.safetyGuidance: Official open community captures curated by the Wireshark development team and community contributors.
instructions: Browse the wiki for target protocols discussed in each module.
Download individual protocol samples to compare against anomalous traffic.
Use for protocol header validation and custom filter creation.
pcapResources.verificationMethod: External community capture index; individual protocol capture hashes maintained upstream

capstone.title: Operation Blackout Beacon — SOC Enterprise Intrusion Forensics
capstone.scenario: Simulated Incident Scenario: In this capstone scenario, an enterprise SOC analyst is presented with a realistic intrusion investigation narrative. Note: The scenario narrative, timestamps, and IP addresses below serve as an illustrative forensic challenge framework, while the analysis is conducted against the real multi-stage capture 'Hackers on the Network.pcapng' created by Netsec Explained. As the Lead Network Forensics Specialist, you have been tasked with investigating the capture, identifying anomalous protocol flows, isolating secondary payloads and beacons, evaluating command-and-control (C2) communication patterns, mapping connection attempts, and compiling a structured technical and executive report.

criteria: Accurately calculates total packet count, byte volume, capture duration, and average data rate
Produces a comprehensive Protocol Hierarchy breakdown identifying top Layer 4 and Layer 7 protocols
Isolates top IP talkers and lists all external IP endpoints communicating with internal subnets
Identifies DNS anomalies, unauthorized DNS resolvers, and suspicious domain lookup spikes
Reconstructs unencrypted HTTP requests, inspecting User-Agents, URIs, and server response codes
Extracts TLS Server Name Indication (SNI) values and validates SSL certificate issuer validity
Pinpoints adversary C2 communication channels and calculates regular beaconing interval/jitter
Carves and hashes the primary dropped executable artifact using Export Objects (HTTP/SMB)
Detects active reconnaissance or brute-force scanning against internal domain controllers
Generates cryptographic SHA256 hashes of original PCAP and extracted forensic artifacts
Documents immutable chain of custody with exact UTC timestamps and sensor interface identifiers
Ensures that no extracted binaries are executed during static network analysis
Builds a chronological UTC timestamped sequence of events from initial probe to exfiltration
Correlates TCP sequence delta timings with adversary interaction pauses and automated script executions
Identifies exact start and stop timestamps of lateral movement and data exfiltration sessions
Authors clear Executive Summary accessible to leadership detailing business impact and root cause
Provides granular Technical Findings section complete with IOC table (IPs, Domains, Hashes, Ports)
Recommends concrete immediate containment measures, network segmentation, and firewall rules

submissionSections.title: Phase 1: Initial PCAP Triage & Endpoint Discovery
submissionSections.prompt: Summarize the capture characteristics: total duration, packet count, primary internal subnets involved, and top external IP endpoints by transmitted byte volume.

submissionSections.title: Phase 2: Protocol Breakdown & DNS/TLS Investigation
submissionSections.prompt: Document all observed DNS queries to anomalous domains, suspicious HTTP User-Agent strings, and external TLS connection hostnames identified via SNI.

submissionSections.title: Phase 3: C2 Detection & Payload Carving
submissionSections.prompt: Identify the exact IP, port, and protocol used for C2 communication. Calculate the beaconing interval and jitter. Provide the filename, size, and SHA256 of any carved executable payloads.

submissionSections.title: Phase 4: Evidence Integrity & Chain of Custody Record
submissionSections.prompt: Record the verification hashes of the evidence capture, specify proper handling procedures for malicious PCAP artifacts, and describe how sanitization would be performed if sharing with external CERTs.

submissionSections.title: Phase 5: Master Intrusion Timeline (UTC)
submissionSections.prompt: Provide a chronological table of key incident milestones: First Probe, Initial Infection / Download, C2 Established, Internal Reconnaissance, Lateral Movement, and Exfiltration.

submissionSections.title: Phase 6: Incident Remediation & SOC Containment Plan
submissionSections.prompt: Write actionable remediation recommendations: immediate firewall egress block rules, DNS sinkholing commands, host isolation priorities, and Snort/Suricata signature recommendations.

modules.title: Module 00: Networking Prerequisites & Lab Preparation
modules.description: Master fundamental networking abstractions, OSI vs. TCP/IP models, frame/packet headers, and prepare your packet capture analysis workstation.

lessons.title: OSI 7-Layer vs. TCP/IP Model & Encapsulation Mechanics
Ethernet Frames, MAC Addressing & ARP Operations
IPv4 & IPv6 Packet Headers, Addressing & Subnetting
TCP Three-Way Handshake, Sequence Numbers & Flags
UDP, ICMP & Core Infrastructure Protocols (DNS, DHCP)

modules.title: Module 01: Wireshark Installation & Interface Mastery
modules.description: Configure high-fidelity packet capture drivers, master interface capture modes, customize forensic profiles, and establish delta timing baselines.

lessons.title: Wireshark Architecture, libpcap/Npcap & Driver Capture Modes
Interface Selection, Promiscuous vs. Monitor Mode & Capture Options
Deep Customization: Coloring Rules, Custom Columns & Profiles
Time Display Formats, Timestamps & TCP Delta Timing Analysis

modules.title: Module 02: Packet Analysis & Protocol Investigation
modules.description: Deconstruct network conversations, master boolean and bitwise display filters, follow multi-protocol streams, and evaluate traffic volume statistics.

lessons.title: Packet Dissection: Packet List, Packet Details & Byte Inspector
Display Filter Syntax & Primitives (Comparison, Logical, Bitwise)
Following TCP, UDP, SSL/TLS, and HTTP Streams
Protocol Hierarchy Statistics & Conversations Table Triage
IO Graphs, Throughput Trends & Round-Trip Time (RTT) Graphing

modules.title: Module 03: Advanced Wireshark Investigation Workflow
modules.description: Execute structured 5-phase forensic triage on unknown captures, dissect TLS sessions, carve embedded payloads, and pinpoint TCP transmission faults.

lessons.title: Investigating Unknown PCAPs: The 5-Phase Forensic Triage Model
Advanced Wireshark Network Forensics - Part 1/3
Dissecting Encrypted Traffic: TLS Handshakes, Cipher Suites & SNI Analysis
Extracting Embedded Objects & File Payloads from Network Streams
Identifying Packet Loss, Window Exhaustion & TCP Zero-Window Events

modules.title: Module 04: Malware Traffic Analysis
modules.description: Analyze multi-stage malware delivery, C2 beaconing frequencies, domain generation algorithms (DGAs), and DNS exfiltration techniques.

lessons.title: Malware Delivery Mechanics: Phishing, Exploitation & Command-and-Control (C2)
Advanced Wireshark Network Forensics - Part 2/3
Identifying C2 Beaconing Patterns & Periodic Heartbeat Signals
DNS Tunneling, Fast-Flux Domains & Exfiltration Detection

modules.title: Module 05: DoS, Reconnaissance & FTP Network Forensics
modules.description: Reconstruct reconnaissance scans, dissect denial of service flood signatures, recover cleartext credentials, and detect lateral movement.

lessons.title: Port Scanning & Network Reconnaissance Fingerprints (Nmap, SYN Scans)
Advanced Wireshark Network Forensics - Part 3/3
Denial of Service (DoS) & SYN Flood Traffic Characterization
Insecure Protocols in the Wild: Cleartext FTP Authentication & Data Channels
Lateral Movement, SMB/RPC Traffic & Remote Execution Signatures

modules.title: Module 06: Command-Line Network Forensics
modules.description: Automate large-scale PCAP triage using TShark, extract specific header fields for SIEM ingestion, slice captures with editcap, and script IOC sweeps.

lessons.title: Introduction to TShark: CLI Packet Dissection & Filter Automation
High-Speed Batch Processing, Field Extraction (-T fields) & CSV Output
Wireshark Command-Line Utilities: capinfos, editcap, and mergecap
Automating IOC Hunting & Forensic PCAP Scripting (Bash & Python)

modules.title: Module 07: Digital Forensics, Evidence & Reporting
modules.description: Ensure legal evidence admissibility, protect chain of custody, sanitize sensitive captures, correlate host and network artifacts, and deliver SOC reports.

lessons.title: Digital Evidence Admissibility, Chain of Custody & Forensic Hashes
Redacting Sensitive PCAP Data: IP Anonymization & Payload Scrubbing
Correlating Network Captures with Host Logs & SIEM Events
Authoring Professional Incident Response & SOC Forensics Reports

modules.title: Module 08: Final SOC Network Forensics Capstone
modules.description: Synthesize your complete forensics skill set in an end-to-end enterprise incident investigation, evidence extraction, timeline reconstruction, and executive report.
